Paper Name: Design optimization of a multi-source renewable energy system using a novel method based on selective ensemble learning
NOTES: Primary results use SEMPA (proposed method). Paper abstract mentions 'superior COE at 0.3127 $/kWh' which matches Table 3 MPA row, but Table 3 SEMPA row shows CEO=0.3115 $/kWh - using SEMPA as primary since it is the proposed/best method. Load profile is IEEE RTS with 50 kW peak; annual energy not explicitly stated (possible inference via standard IEEE RTS load factor ~0.51 would give ~225 MWh/yr but NOT used). System is PV/WT/FC only (no diesel generator). Optimization variable bounds: 0-2000. No explicit component efficiencies (eta_PV, eta_FC, eta_EL, eta_INVT) stated. No H2_LHV given. No wind turbine cut-in/cut-out/rated speeds specified. No diesel-related parameters (f_0, f_1, Cap_DG, c_DG_cap, c_DG_FUEL, e_DG, life_DG, P_DG_min). A_PV not specified. Inverter rated capacity reported as 800 $/kW (1 kW unit). LPSPmax = 5% used in optimization. Nominal interest = 9%, inflation = 3%, real interest = 6%. MHTS = Mass of Hydrogen Tank Storage. CoE and LCOE used interchangeably (COE reported in paper). N_EL/N_FC not separate unit counts; electrolyzer and fuel cell capacities are continuous power ratings in kW.
